name: Band Shoulder Press
steps: Stand tall on the middle of a resistance band with feet hip-width apart and hold the ends just outside your shoulders.
Brace your abs and glutes tightly while stacking your wrists directly above your elbows.
Press both hands straight overhead until your arms extend smoothly beside your ears.
Lower your hands slowly back to shoulder height under steady tension.
tips: Keep your wrists straight over your elbows throughout the press.
Avoid leaning backward or flaring your rib cage as the band reaches peak tension.
